text: Released worker8 2026-09-10: core wrap_sos_payload/classifier landed in 9c9da821a4, but no lichen-node SOS sender or canonical CBOR construction exists. stack.rs only exposes IPv6/SCHC transmit paths; rpl_stack/receive.rs drops Sos.
